cycles.title: Thirty proof-directed survivors
cycles.goal: Generate a larger candidate pool, reject circular or non-progressive routes, and admit exactly thirty hypotheses with explicit proof roles after immediate falsification attempts.
cycles.result: All thirty admitted statements survived their two recorded attacks. Survival does not imply truth. Twelve additional candidates were rejected for circularity, invalid consequence, hidden oracle, missing explicitness, or lack of a proof-directed role.
next_actions: Formalize H035 as a graph-diameter lower-bound problem for the exact circuit rewriting relation.
Implement a small exhaustive counterexample search for concrete H041 and H048 rule sets.
Attempt the H050 translation from certified elimination interfaces to ordinary DNNF.
Split H059 into one fixed finite field and one fixed circuit cost model before any proof attempt.
cycles.claim_boundary: C006 adds research obligations, not a proof or probability assessment of P versus NP.
